text:
incident-bot: PAGED eve-oncall — metering: token_count drift detected (window aggregation). ~120 customers seeing spuriously high token counts; overage flags firing. Auto-alert threshold crossed.

incident-bot: Details: emitter-latency spike -> duplicate ack observed from emitter v2.3.2, backlog in redis-stream. Suspected duplicate replays.

eve-oncall: acked — I'm on it. pinging billing and SRE.

alice-sre: oncall joining. initial check: redis stream consumer lag ~6k, emitter pod restarted 3 times in last 5m. Could be duplicate messages on retry.

bob-billing: looking at billing pipeline — overage flags are coming from charge-aggregator v1 increment events. Confirming customer list now.

carla-product: any customer-facing impact known? dave-cs please check open support threads.

dave-cs: two customers reported unexpected overage emails in last 10m, support tickets created (TKT-1342, TKT-1343). No billing adjustments yet.

eve-oncall: plan: 1) pause emitter to stop further increments, 2) enable shadow-debounce to stop flags, 3) run fast-reconcile to compute true counts, 4) temporary credit for impacted customers. Agree?

alice-sre: can do. to pause emitter: `kubectl -n billing scale deployment metering-emitter --replicas=0` then disable emitter cron. I'll run now.

alice-sre: Ran scale command, replicas -> 0. emitter pods terminating. Confirmed no new increments after ~45s.

bob-billing: suggest disabling downstream flagger as well: `POST /internal/flags/debounce?service=charge-aggregator` (internal). I'll pause flagging so customers don't keep getting emails.

frank-ml: note — tokenization service produced duplicate event ids for long sequences; model-side kv-cache replays might cause re-emission. We'll open a model-runtime ticket but not blocking mitigation.

gina-eng: will snapshot current ledger and start fast-reconcile job: `jobs/reconcile --mode=delta --since=2026-03-17T09:30Z` It will compute canonical counts and emit diffs for backfill.

eve-oncall: good. product + cs: draft a short customer note? we should be transparent: say we identified an ingestion duplication and are reconciling counts, credits forthcoming.

carla-product: drafting note. keep it brief, no blame. send to legal if you want but probably ok.

dave-cs: sending note to affected customers now, offering temporary credit and ETA for reconciliation (target 2h).

alice-sre: starting reconcile run now. ETA ~30-45m for first pass on impacted window. Jobs kicked off on batch cluster.

bob-billing: once reconcile diff is ready we'll run `billing/reapply --mode=backfill --dry-run` then validate before applying. Also prepping credit ledger entries for manual apply.

frank-ml: adding model-runtime team to thread, we should patch emitter to dedupe on event_id in next deploy.

eve-oncall: summary for next-handoff: emitter paused, flagging paused, reconcile running, customer note sent, credits queued manual apply. If anyone takes over next shift pls monitor reconcile job + support queue. Next update in 15m.

alice-sre: reconcile pass 1 complete — results: ~0.9% of total tokens in window are duplicates; 118 customers with net positive delta that triggered flags. Reconcile diffs staged at s3://redwood-reconciles/1757552468/diff.csv

bob-billing: dry-run backfill shows 118 refunds/credits required, aggregate credit ~ $2.4k. Approved to apply after bob-billing review.

dave-cs: support queue: customers acknowledged note and paused escalations. two customers asked for immediate manual credit — processing those now.

eve-oncall: ok proceed with backfill apply after billing runs final validation. I'll stay on for the apply.

bob-billing: applied backfill and updated charge ledger. Confirmed overage flags cleared for 116 of 118 customers. Two required manual review due to edge-case plan mappings.

gina-eng: we've queued a postmortem-runbook: root cause appears to be emitter retry path that didn't attach a stable id for large prompts; added dedupe guard. Patch PR open: gh/eng/emit-dedupe#789.

carla-product: prepping public postmortem draft and customer FAQ. Will coordinate with ops for distribution.

eve-oncall: handing off to alice-sre for follow-up and post-incident actions. I will remain reachable for 30m.

alice-sre: taking over as investigator-on-call. next steps: monitor for replays for 2h, ensure patch deploy to emitter dedupe reaches canary, run finer-grain reconciliation overnight. Filing incident ticket INC-2026-045.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress — emitter paused, flags paused, reconcile completed and backfill applied. Customer credits issued. Severity reduced to P3.

carla-product: thanks team. please add any remaining tasks to INC-2026-045 and we'll review in postmortem.

dave-cs: closing related support tickets once final confirmations come through.

eve-oncall: thanks all — great coordination.

alice-sre: last check: redis-stream lag cleared, no new duplicate events after emitter pause. Logging more conservatively for the next deploy.

frank-ml: PR merged for dedupe; will schedule canary deploy in next maintenance window.

gina-eng: archived reconcile artifacts and uploaded to incident timeline.

carla-product: marking communications closed for now. will ping if any customer follow-ups escalate.

alice-sre: logging post-incident actions in INC ticket. closing thread for live mitigation.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: emitter paused -> patch deployed to staging. Monitor window: 2h.
